key_decisions.decision: Retains exact seven sprinklings and all named furnishings, distinct from Aaron’s poured oil.
Uses passive for unnamed slaughterer, preserves Moses’ finger/horns/base actions, and interprets atonement on altar with alternative for altar noted.
Retains carcass contents, real disposal outside camp and command refrain, distinct from altar burning.
Leaves unnamed slaughterer unassigned and preserves named Moses’ splashing, not sprinkling.
Retains second ram and distinct ordination category, connecting filling-hands idiom in note.
Keeps all three right-side body sites and partial blood quantity, without replacing rite with symbolic explanation.
Repeats all three sites for the sons and distinguishes bodily application from altar splashing.
Keeps one of each of three bread forms, basket location and placement on both fat and thigh.
Preserves physical hands, all items and wave rite with the disputed waving agent left unassigned, and terminology consistent with Exodus 29.
Keeps transfer from hands, placement on earlier offering and plural ordination designation with aroma/fire language.
Retains oil and altar blood and full repeated people/garments list, distinguishing sprinkling from earlier pouring.
Keeps boiling and eating location, basket and source first-person I-commanded inside Moses’ speech.
Preserves location restriction, repeated exact seven days and fulfillment language, with filling-hands idiom explained selectively.
Keeps current-day action, divine command and atonement for priests, using passive for unexpressed agent.
Retains day/night residence, third seven-day statement, charge and death warning without softening consequence.
